name: Clienta Booking
author: clienta

sections.description:
The Clienta Booking plugin allows your customers to book appointments directly on your WordPress website. The widget is fully integrated with your Clienta account.

Clienta is a Dutch appointment booking platform for service providers like hairdressers, beauty salons, nail studios, and personal trainers.

Features:

  • Floating booking button on every page
  • Inline widget via shortcode
  • Customizable colors and button text
  • Multi-language support (Dutch, English, German, Spanish, Turkish)
  • Mobile-friendly responsive design
  • Seamless integration with Clienta’s booking system

How does it work?

  1. Create a free Clienta account at clienta.nl
  2. Set up your services and availability
  3. Install this plugin and enter your Clienta slug
  4. Customers can now book directly through your website!

Requirements:

This plugin requires a Clienta Pro or Full Service subscription to function. The widget connects to your Clienta account to display your services, availability, and process bookings.

External Service Connection:

This plugin connects to Clienta (clienta.nl) to provide its booking functionality. When the widget is displayed on your website, it loads an embed script and iframe from Clienta’s servers to show your services, availability, and process customer bookings.

  • Service Provider: Clienta (clienta.nl)
  • Data Transmitted: Your Clienta business slug (public identifier)
  • Data Received: Your services, availability, and booking widget interface
  • Privacy Policy: https://clienta.nl/privacy
  • Terms of Service: https://clienta.nl/terms

This external connection is essential for the plugin to function, as all booking data is stored and managed on Clienta’s platform. No personal data is sent from WordPress to Clienta – customers enter their information directly in the Clienta widget.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/clienta-booking directory, or install the plugin directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → Clienta Booking to enter your Clienta slug.
sections.faq:
Where do I find my Clienta slug?

Log in at clienta.nl, go to Settings → Website Widget. There you will find your unique slug.

Can I place the widget on a specific page?

Yes! Use the shortcode [clienta_booking] on any page where you want to display the booking widget inline.

Does this work with my theme?

The Clienta widget works with any WordPress theme. The floating button appears at the bottom right of your website.

Do I need a Pro account?

Yes, the website widget feature is available for Clienta Pro and Full Service subscribers.

What is Clienta?

Clienta is a Dutch SaaS platform for appointment booking, designed for service providers like salons, barbershops, beauticians, and personal trainers. Learn more at clienta.nl.
